steps.content: Under the sunlight, in the seawater, in every building, the sounds of joy are never-ending.
Ordinary desires, strange desires, everything is here. In every corner, there are people satisfying their desires.

Some guests have become so rich that they'd purposely spend a fortune on a toothpick; some are soaking happily in a bathtub filled with gold coins, casually burning banknotes; and some crave recognition, wanting to be seen by everyone, now every news outlet are going crazy over even the smallest thing they do.
And there are those unspeakable, indescribable feasts. Desires that make every cell sigh with satisfaction, making the body continuously secrete exciting and joyful hormones and compounds.
L.L.'s avatars hum little tunes, bouncing slightly as they walk on this Elysiland.

As soon as they see her, the guests stand up, wave and raise their glasses to L.L. The amber liquid inside crashes against the glass walls like waves, overflowing with foam, as they offer their sincerest thanks to L.L., the owner of the island.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: This is amazing! I've never eaten so much, and had so many pretty girls around me. Elysiland is just awesome!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yup, yup! That's right! There's nothing you can't have here, whatever you want to eat, I got it all! So delicious it makes your soul tremble!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Oh, thank you! The manga here is so complete! I never thought I'd see my favorite in my lifetime! It's such a highly restricted and rare piece of work!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: On this island, no manga or anime is restricted. If you want to watch, you can watch to your heart's content! You can even have the author tied up in front of you to watch them draw!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: I'm so happy, so many friends... This place is heaven!
L.L. watches, listens, and smells the accumulating happiness of people, her projections swim like little fish in the sea, wandering among the joyful crowd.

steps.speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
steps.content: You want to be respected, become a superstar, or spread happiness? Or maybe you just want to spend the whole day gaming and eating junk food? No problem!

steps.speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
steps.content: Whether it's big dreams or small thoughts, as long as everyone is happy!

steps.speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
steps.content: Don't hold back, enjoy to your heart's content!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Enjoy! Your happiness is my happiness!
She floats alone in the vast swimming pool, letting the water push her body to wander around.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Everyone should have let go of their burdens, right? Yes, that's it, free yourself, enjoy freedom.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Let me feel your joy too! Let's see how you all enjoy yourselves.
Dazzling arrays of digits and variables gradually float to the surface of the water, and tiny electric particles seep into every corner of the island through the pool water.
She closes her eyes, links to everyone, digitizes and copies everyone's emotions, incorporating them into her body. As time passes, L.L. slowly sinks into the water.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...It's so nice, it must be fun to play with them...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But time is almost up... Now, I should do the final check to see who isn't happy enough and which guests haven't been attended to.
Unexpectedly, she notices a small flaw—a strange figure. That person seems to have noticed L.L.'s electric particles and disappears swiftly.
L.L. tries to chase after that figure, but only catch a vague outline. She opens her eyes wide, whispering in surprise at this data.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...No invitation, not authenticated... It's an illegal login, 30 minutes ago... now hidden...

steps.speaker: Shawn hangs up abruptly before the girl can finish.
steps.content: The intruder is... someone in a gray trench coat...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Interesting... not satisfied by anything on this Elysiland after arriving for 30 whole minutes?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And even have done something bad? Hehe, it's okay, it's okay...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Time is up.
It happens so abruptly.
The money covering them vanishes instantly. The last bite of steak disappears. The once sturdy body abruptly deflates. The warmth in their embrace dissipates, turning into cold desolation.
People gather displeasingly and anxiously in the central square of the island, starting to complain.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Huh? Where's my A5 Wagyu? Where's my truffle rice with caviar? I haven't had enough yet!!!!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Honey! Where did you go, honey? How can I live without you, honey!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Is there a thief? Did a thief come here?! Or is it a malfunction?! I was having so much fun, what's going on!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: Where is the island owner? Help us, something's wrong in Elysiland!
Shhh... Calm down, calm down. There's no thief, and it's not a malfunction, it's just that time is up.
Flickering particles gather, L.L. with her usual smile, floats above the crowd, tilts her head, and speaks.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Although the sun of Elysiland always shines, a wonderful day has to come to an end as time passes. Did everyone have fun? Are you satisfied?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest D
steps.content: Huh... what?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Be honest with yourself, indulge in yourself! Squeeze every second of today here and now, make it unforgettable for a lifetime!
As people come to their senses, they remember the initial agreement. They open their mouths wide, their expressions changing from ecstasy to surprise, and now to a sense of loss. L.L. sees it all.
She gracefully lands, stands in the middle of the crowd, opens her arms, bows like an actor taking a curtain call, and then points to the nearby dock.
Sure enough, a large ship is already docked there, and Captain Meow, who took everyone out to sea fishing, stands on top of the ship, waving its tail at everyone.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Don't worry, I've prepared the ship. It will take everyone home safely.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Return to reality. Go back to your lives. Those important people and things are still waiting for you.
L.L. wipes her moist eyes, reluctantly bids everyone farewell. After waving her hand, countless avatars appear once again in the crowd, holding the guests' hands, leading them to the ship.

steps.speaker: L.L. Avatar
steps.content: Although all of this is an illusion, a well-made fabrication of mine, I hope you had enough fun and will remember this sense of freedom and joy.

steps.speaker: L.L. Avatar
steps.content: Ah... also, remember me too.
Many people have already boarded the ship, but they still crowd at the stern, showing reluctance and helplessness.
...Until someone refuses to let go of L.L.'s hand.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest D
steps.content: ...I had a great time today, it was so satisfying. So... can I stay a little longer?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guests
steps.content: Elysiland is such a wonderful place... Is a day really all we can have?
A gentle question, yet it resonates loudly. Almost everyone raises their heads, looking at L.L., their eyes showing the same desire, hoping for L.L.'s affirmative answer.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But... but this is all fake.
L.L. covers her mouth, deliberately widens her eyes, looking at all the guests.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest F
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...No matter how realistic Elysiland is, it's all an illusion created by dark web codes... Although it can infinitely satisfy everyone's desires, it can also bring strange side effects.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: One day, 24 hours, is the longest safe limit I've carefully calculated. If you stay longer, the people at the Public Security Bureau will come to catch you...!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: So, for your own good, you must leave when it's time. You know this in your hearts, don't you?
She swims like a beautiful little fish to the guest's side, gently lifts the guest's chin, and caresses her hair.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: After all, what I can give you is only momentary pleasure and excitement. Shallow. Nothing more.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Those deeper bonds, ideals, and real growth and comfort... Elysiland can't give you that. Go back to your important reality and look for them.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: So, don't act spoiled with me. You should go back. I wish you all a safe journey!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: But I don't want to go home! It's exhausting to deal with my parents, and online part-time jobs are boring. I'll just play with my phone if I go back anyway, might as well stay here!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Exactly! Work is stressful, and nothing tastes good. But here, it's finally peaceful, I can eat freely without worrying about getting fat!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: ...You're right... My family, my job, they're still waiting for me. But...

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: We understand what you're saying, but one day is really too short. Can we have one more day? We can handle it, our bodies are fine!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: Or... half a day? An hour?
Guests reach out to her, some even trying to grab her feet; everyone is using their own methods to try to keep L.L. from leaving.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But...
Facing the guests who are pleading with her, L.L. lowers her head, showing a troubled expression, but there seems to be a hint of a smile.
The crowd gradually becomes restless, more and more people descend the gangway, trying to discern some room for negotiation from L.L.'s reaction.
They beg, reaching out to touch L.L. or even just the hem of her clothes.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Why...? Do you not want to go back?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Male Guest
steps.content: It's so great here, let us stay a little longer, even if it's just for a while.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Even if there are more important things and people waiting for you on the other side?

steps.speaker: Excited Female Guest
steps.content: It's okay. We'll just stay a bit longer. You said that passion and desire are equally important.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Do... do you really think so?
L.L.'s hand slightly clenches into a fist, covering her lips, looking as if moved by everyone's sincerity, but no one notices the trembling smile behind her palm.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guests
steps.content: Yes! You said you would satisfy us, so satisfy us to the end of it!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Female Guest
steps.content: We'll leave when we're satisfied. We won't trouble you!
Everyone is overwhelmed by their desire for pleasure, their need for satisfaction is like withdrawal symptoms, gnawing at them. L.L. looks at the people with a different gleam in her eyes.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: B-but as the owner of this island, I have a responsibility...
Noticing the wavering in L.L.'s tone, a gray figure in the crowd suddenly pushes forward, shouting loudly as he reaches out to stop the people who are continuously surging towards L.L.
steps.female_content: Noticing the wavering in L.L.'s tone, a gray figure in the crowd suddenly pushes forward, shouting loudly as she reaches out to stop the people who are continuously surging towards L.L.

steps.content: But the crowd erupts into deafening shouts, completely drowning him out. At this moment, seeing the dawn of victory, everyone on the island is yelling at L.L.
steps.female_content: But the crowd erupts into deafening shouts, completely drowning her out. At this moment, seeing the dawn of victory, everyone on the island is yelling at L.L.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: No, don't hesitate! Didn't you say you were happy with us? Then we'll stay with you!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: As long as we can stay, anything is fine, we promise to make you happy!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: Didn't you invite us here to make yourself happy?

At the distant poolside, she watches the only person trying to disrupt this revelry, watching him try to dissuade those who can't be pulled back. L.L. smiles and waves her hand, isolating him from the other guests—she prefers to listen to the ebullient and eager shouts of the people.
steps.female_content: At the distant poolside, she watches the only person trying to disrupt this revelry, watching her try to dissuade those who can't be pulled back. L.L. smiles and waves her hand, isolating her from the other guests—she prefers to listen to the ebullient and eager shouts of the people.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...Oh my, oh my, look at them, look at these enthusiastic guests!

L.L. props herself up on the edge of the pool, struggling to support her body. Her overly pale skin emerges from the water, her feet trembling as they touch the ground. The thin cloth clings to her body, water continuously dripping from the smooth surface, causing her exposed skin to sting.
It's like giving birth—L.L. can't stand steadily, can't move, her breathing becomes rapid, she can't even lift her head, yet she's smiling.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You know it's shallow, and it's wrong; you know there are more important things, and you should learn to endure and mature... Yet there are just things that you want to indulge in, even if it means corruption.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That is the deepest, most selfish desire in everyone's heart! Hahaha! Since you all insist, how could I disappoint you?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You're right! In this Elysiland, the happiest person is me, and the one most reluctant to leave is also me!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I'm so happy! So many people are like me, I understand your joy, now you understand me too! We are friends now!
All her avatars instantly disperse into particles, the real L.L. appears on the beach, standing alone in the center of the revelry, in the center of the vortex of desire.

Her eyes sparkle with excitement as she looks at her guests, her face flushed and her body trembling. After being away from the sea for so long, she can't help but gasp continuously, and uses all her strength to utter every word.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Since everyone has the best and most intense desires, let's indulge a little longer!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Because I can't help it either! Come on, let's indulge together, let's sink together, let's fall together!!!
She opens her arms to embrace everyone, as a nearly sky-covering tidal wave instantly surrounds the entire island.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Those willing to stay! You deserve even more supreme pleasure!
Behind her, within the giant wave, a monster almost the size of the entire island flaps its fins, continuously emitting terrifying sound waves.
The crowd is ablaze with excitement, cheering and rushing towards L.L., all infected by her fervor.
The only out-of-place person wears a gray trench coat, trying hard to stop them but fails, blocked outside the crowd, gritting his teeth, looking in L.L.'s direction.
steps.female_content: The only out-of-place person wears a gray trench coat, trying hard to stop them but fails, blocked outside the crowd, gritting her teeth, looking in L.L.'s direction.

steps.content: L.L. smiles.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Ah... what a wonderful look in your eyes, I should have invited you, you would fit in perfectly here.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But next, I'll take them to an even happier place, you'll have to find a way to come yourself.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The revelry has already begun, if you want to stop me, join in first.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Set sail, my friends! The real me is now by your side, it's time to venture into deeper waters, to enjoy even greater pleasure! We've had enough of the sea view, now let's admire the wonders under the ocean!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Continue to please yourself, just like you please me!
Following the command, the gigantic monster screeches and stirs up a colossal tidal wave, leaping to the top of the island, piercing down fiercely!
The entire island starts to shake violently, sinking rapidly under the monster's wings.
The seawater instantly engulfs the land, submerging everyone's heads, causing them to struggle in near despair.
But as the feeling of suffocation grows stronger, the pleasure hidden beneath the pain also gradually emerges, becoming more evident and more addictive!
L.L. slowly sinks along with the island and the guests, watching the satisfied and joyful expressions on the faces of the people, and slowly closes her eyes.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Come, join me... let's sink into indulgence together.
